_why: The one place any UI colour is written down. The desktop stylesheet and the web stylesheet are both rendered from this file, so the two front-ends cannot drift apart. Adding a colour here is a decision you make once; hardcoding one in a stylesheet is a bug.

_meaning.room: the dim reading room — the window behind everything
_meaning.room2: raised chrome: toolbars, buttons, status bar
_meaning.hover: the same chrome, under the pointer
_meaning.film: the lit surface the report is written on — the brightest thing on screen
_meaning.textDim: labels and anything the eye should skip
_meaning.glow: the machine's voice: selection, focus, assistive suggestions. Never severity.
_meaning.rec: recording, and clinical severity. Nothing else, ever.
_meaning.warn: one step below severity: a mic level that is too low to trust
_meaning.ok: a level that is healthy, a step that completed
